entities.name: Joseph Augustine Di Noia

entities.summary: Joseph Augustine Di Noia is an American member of the Dominican Order who is a Roman Catholic archbishop and theologian. Since 2013 he has been adjunct secretary of the Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith. He has held several other positions in the Roman Curia since 2002.
